pitches.idea: Noir sparring series — raw, unpolished, one continuous round, no cuts.
“The Unseen Round” — a 60-second vertical reel tracking one girl’s sparring session from glove lace-up to final bell, cut only at breath pauses.
“The Glove Check” — A hyper-stylized micro-documentary of one boxer’s pre-round ritual, synced to the exact 3-minute bell.
“The 3-Second Reset” — A tight, slow-motion study of what happens between rounds in a girl’s sparring session, focusing only on the exhale, the towel wipe, and the stare.
"The Corner Cut" — A split-screen study of two girls sparring, showing the exact moment each absorbs a hit and resets, synced to a single breath cycle.
"The Stitch" — a macro close-up sequence following the thread of a single glove lace, from unlacing post-sparring to rewrapping, as the boxer’s breathing is the only sound.
“The Last Wrap” — a single continuous shot following one girl’s hand wrap from roll to fist, ending as the glove closes over it, with her exhale as the only sound.
